title: Economic Critique Of Imperialism
definition: The systematic intellectual framework developed by early Indian nationalists (Moderate Era) that exposed how British colonial rule systematically drained India's wealth, stifled indigenous industry, and reduced India to a raw material supplier and a market for British manufactured goods.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE Prelims (history factual depth on Moderate leaders, drain theory, books) and GS-1/GS-2 Mains (critical evaluation of colonial economic policies, roots of underdevelopment, and Indian nationalist response).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Economic Critique Of Imperialism.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions of the Drain of Wealth.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions regarding nationalist leaders and their works.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of British conquest of India and the phases of British economic policy (Mercantilism, Industrial Capitalism, Finance Imperialism).
